runs.title: Strict proxy in front of a strict origin

instrumented.title: Content-Length + Transfer-Encoding (front trusts CL)
instrumented.why: A hop that obeys Content-Length reads the chunked-looking tail as body; a hop that obeys Transfer-Encoding reads it as a new request.

instrumented.title: Transfer-Encoding + Content-Length (front trusts TE)
instrumented.why: The front decodes a short chunked body; the back obeys Content-Length, stops inside the chunk framing and turns the remainder into a request.

instrumented.title: Duplicate Transfer-Encoding, unknown coding after chunked
instrumented.why: One hop drops an unrecognised coding and still finds 'chunked'; another treats the list as unusable and falls back to Content-Length.

instrumented.title: Transfer-Encoding value with trailing whitespace
instrumented.why: If one hop fails to trim the value it no longer sees the token 'chunked'.

instrumented.title: chunked followed by identity
instrumented.why: Some hops accept 'identity' as terminating the list, others keep looking and never find chunked last.

instrumented.title: Whitespace before the colon on a second TE header
instrumented.why: A lenient hop accepts the folded-in header; a strict one discards it.

instrumented.title: Transfer-Encoding: chunked sent twice
instrumented.why: Hops differ on whether a repeated coding list is legal or collapses to a single chunked body.

instrumented.title: Duplicate Content-Length, large first / small second
instrumented.why: First-wins and last-wins hops disagree on the body length, so one hop leaves a request's worth of bytes in the stream.

instrumented.title: Duplicate Content-Length, small first / large second
instrumented.why: The mirror image: a last-wins front and a first-wins back desync.

instrumented.title: Bare-LF line terminators in the head
instrumented.why: Hops that accept bare LF agree with CRLF hops on where lines end, but some forward the raw bytes while rejecting them downstream.

instrumented.title: Leading whitespace before the chunk size
instrumented.why: A lenient hop skips the space and decodes the chunk; a strict one errors or treats it as a different size.

instrumented.title: Chunk extension on the chunk-size line
instrumented.why: Hops that mishandle the extension mis-locate the chunk data.
